item.title: a short note about writing clearly
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Short post: writing clearly is one of those things that looks simple until it isn’t.

why it matters

Writing clearly shows up across writing work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Name it after what it does, not after how it does it.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
